data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'layon', meaning 'laurel'. In Greek mythology, laurel was believed to be the food of the gods and symbolized victory and glory. The name Layney evokes the idea of divine favor, success, and prosperity. The name Layney carries the meaning “Laurel's nectar” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Layney usually hope their child will grow to embody laurel's nectar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
